pages.title: Collect the patterns
pages.text: Blueprint Storage holds six blueprints for a directly adjacent Constructor or Auto Constructor; any face works. A populated blueprint shows its result and ingredients. Blank blueprints teach no recipe.$(br2)The upper slots show stored patterns. The lower grid shows your whole inventory, with a separated hotbar. Blueprints are bright; other items are dimmed and cannot be selected or transferred. Double-click a slot to transfer, or select one and use the up/down arrows. Patterns stay in storage after crafting. Keep useful blueprints from your travels.
This starter library uses ordinary crafting. Marble colors may be mixed. You do not need an existing library to make it.

pages.title: Load your library
pages.text: Open Blueprint Storage and double-click its displayed slots to transfer blueprints between it and your inventory.$(br2)Blueprints stay in the library after crafting. Add more adjacent storage blocks for more patterns.$(br2)If you use JEI, look up a Constructor recipe to see its blueprint, ingredients and full output.

Place any three valid blueprints in a crafting grid, in any arrangement. They are consumed to give one different pattern. The result is revealed when you craft it, including with shift-click. Blank blueprints cannot be exchanged.

pages.title: Blueprint rarity
pages.text: Tooltips show $(thing)Common, Uncommon, Rare or Extreme$(). Exchanging averages the three tier numbers (0, 1, 2, 3), rounded to the nearest tier. The result has a $(thing)10%$() chance to move one tier down, $(thing)20%$() to move up and otherwise stays in the same tier. Moves beyond the endpoints stay at that endpoint.$(br2)All three input patterns are excluded. If the chosen tier has no other patterns, the nearest available tier is used, preferring the lower tier on a tie. Disabled recipes cannot be awarded.

pages.title: Without Ariente World
pages.text: Explore villages, shipwrecks, ocean ruins, buried treasure, strongholds and other vanilla structures. With default settings, supported chests have an $(thing)80% chance$() to add $(thing)five blueprints$(). One is a core machine or component pattern to help start your workshop.$(br2)The other four each roll 65% Common, 20% Uncommon, 13% Rare and 2% Extreme, then choose a random enabled recipe in that tier. Use duplicate patterns in the three-blueprint exchange.$(br2)These bonuses apply only without ArienteWorld; its city rewards keep their own balance.
